quotes.text: `commands/graph/build.mjs::supportsArtifactBuild()` permits frontend/resource changes; native code, WebIDL, `Cargo.lock`, CMake, Gecko/shared changes, build-setting changes, or uncertain source inspection require a normal build. `supportsArtifactMozBuild()` further permits resource registrations such as `EXTRA_JS_MODULES` and frontend `MOZ_SRC_FILES`; native/build statements still require normal output. [Task 1][Task 2]
